name: Few edges in 5-uniform hypergraphs without Property B (m(5))
description: construct() -> {'n': n, 'edges': [[v1, ..., v5], ...]}: distinct 5-element edges on vertices 0..n-1 with 5 <= n <= 26 and at most 200 edges. The hypergraph must have no proper 2-colouring (no colouring of the vertices leaves every edge with both colours), checked exactly by backtracking with unit propagation. Minimize the number of edges. A valid hypergraph with e edges certifies m(5) <= e; the best known construction has 51 edges and every 5-uniform hypergraph with at most 28 edges is 2-colourable.

sources.locator: Sachin Aglave, V. A. Amarnath, Saswata Shannigrahi and Shwetank Singh, Improved bounds for uniform hypergraphs without property B (2020). Australasian Journal of Combinatorics article inspected: m(5) >= 29 (new lower bound) and m(5) <= 51 from the Abbott-Hanson construction on the Fano plane (16 + 5*7 edges); Table 1 lists m(2) = 3, m(3) = 7, m(4) = 23 (Seymour; Östergård). OEIS A392185 inspected (29 <= a(5) <= 51). Erdős Problem #901 page inspected (bounds sqrt(n/log n) 2^n << m(n) << n^2 2^n). The 51-edge construction was rebuilt locally on 17 vertices and verified non-2-colourable by exhaustive search. A valid hypergraph with e edges certifies m(5) <= e; the best known construction has 51 edges and every 5-uniform hypergraph with at most 28 edges is 2-colourable.
